# S649 — give the gate a separate place to report an intended base-overlay revert failure, so it is not counted on the Tests line

**Findings:**  · **Size:**  · **Tree:**

**2026-11-27** — Owner decision (adj 658): a gate-only line 'Intended red: N failed' that CheckReport reads into a new Report field; it adds nothing to Passed or Failed, so PASS reports failed tests no longer fires for it; non-gate roles' line is ignored. Gate prompt, docs/design.md and report_test.go. Jon chose 'Separate evidence line', session 8d711f67, 2026-11-27.

trust: unverified; by: Jon Robbins

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

The gate reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261127-183721-0a4e, project ork, item S527. Its round-1 report was refused with "PASS reports failed tests". The gate had run the base overlay `overlay-1.json` to prove that a new test fails without the product change. That run fails by design, and the gate had to put it on the `Tests: N passed, M failed` line, the only line it had for test results. `CheckReport` (`internal/engine/report.go:231`) refuses a gate PASS whose summed `Failed` is above zero. The same refusal hit item S455 in ork run ork-20261127-194939-ea1c (adj 656).

The owner decided on 2026-11-27 (adj 658, `gate.intended-red-line`, option evidence-line) on a separate gate-only line, `Intended red: N failed`. `CheckReport` reads it into a new `Report` field. It adds nothing to `Passed` or `Failed`, so `PASS reports failed tests` does not fire for it. A non-gate role's line is ignored. The change covers the gate prompt, `docs/design.md` and `report_test.go`.

Owner decision, 2026-11-27: adj 658 (a separate gate-only Intended red: N failed line).

## Failing tests

- TestCheckReportGateReadsIntendedRedLine (`internal/engine/report_test.go`): a gate PASS report with `Tests: 5 passed, 0 failed` and `Intended red: 2 failed` returns no error, with `Passed == 5`, `Failed == 0`, `HasTests` true and `IntendedRed == 2`. The line is accepted with each list marker (`- `, `* `, `+ `, `1. `, `1) `, `12.\t`) and with a CRLF line end. Two `Intended red:` lines add up (1 and 2 give 3). Fails first: `Report` has no `IntendedRed` field.
- TestCheckReportIntendedRedLineKeepsItsShape (`internal/engine/report_test.go`): a gate PASS report holding a valid Tests line and one of these lines is still accepted, with `IntendedRed == 0` and `Failed == 0`: `Intended red: 1 failed (overlay)`, `Intended red: one failed`, `Intended red: 1 passed`, `Intended red: 1 Failed`, `see Intended red: 1 failed`, `  Intended red: 1 failed`, `intended red: 1 failed`. A malformed line is ignored, not a shape error. The valid form is proved first in the same test, so the cases cannot pass because the line was ignored.
- TestCheckReportIntendedRedDoesNotRescueFailedTests (`internal/engine/report_test.go`): a gate PASS report with `Tests: 2 passed, 1 failed` and `Intended red: 1 failed` is refused with `PASS reports failed tests`. The same text with `VERDICT: FAIL` returns `Passed == 2`, `Failed == 1` and `IntendedRed == 1`. A gate report with only `Intended red: 1 failed` and no Tests line is refused with a problem that mentions `Tests:`. The `Tests: relied on ork round results` line with `Intended red: 1 failed` is accepted with `RelianceOnRound` and `IntendedRed == 1`.
- TestCheckReportIntendedRedLineIsGateOnly (`internal/engine/report_test.go`): an implementer report and a part report with `Tests: 3 passed, 0 failed` and `Intended red: 2 failed` are accepted, with `IntendedRed == 0`, `Passed == 3` and `Failed == 0`. A reviewer report with the line is accepted with `IntendedRed == 0`.
- TestGatePromptNamesTheIntendedRedLine (`internal/roles/roles_test.go`): the gate prompt holds `Intended red: N failed`, `base overlay` and `not on the Tests line`. The implementer and reviewer prompts do not hold `Intended red:`. Fails first: the prompt has no such text.

## Implement

1. Write the failing tests above and watch each fail for the reason given.
2. In `internal/engine/report.go`, add `IntendedRed int` to `Report`, with a comment: the count of the gate's `Intended red: N failed` lines, evidence of a base-overlay revert run that fails by design; it is never added to `Passed` or `Failed`.
3. In `internal/engine/report.go`, add `var intendedRedLine = regexp.MustCompile(`(?m)^(?:(?:[-*+]|\d+[.)])[ \t]+)?Intended red: (\d+) failed\r?$`)`. Use the same list marker form and the same strict whole-line match as `testsLine` (adj 636). Cite adj 658 in its comment.
4. In `CheckReport`, in the `role == RoleGate` branch only, run `intendedRedLine.FindAllStringSubmatch(text, -1)` and add each count to `rep.IntendedRed`. Do not touch `Passed`, `Failed` or `HasTests`. A gate report with no Tests line still gets the `no "Tests: N passed, M failed" line` problem. A line that does not match is ignored, with no shape error. The `PASS reports failed tests` check stays as it is. Extend the `CheckReport` doc comment to name the line.
5. In `internal/roles/prompts/gate.md`, add one bullet to the Report list after the `Tests:` bullet. It says: when you ran a base overlay to show that a test fails without the product change, report that run on its own line `Intended red: N failed`, with N the integer count of tests that failed by design, and not on the Tests line; the line may start with a list marker; ork does not count it as a failed test, so it does not stop a PASS. Add `Intended red: N failed` to the fenced example beside `Tests: N passed, M failed`. Change the sentence "put skipped or blocked tests elsewhere, not on the Tests line" so that it also says the overlay run's failures go on the `Intended red:` line, not on the Tests line. Use the exact phrases `Intended red: N failed`, `base overlay` and `not on the Tests line`.
6. In `docs/design.md`, extend the Report checks bullet (`:1499-1506`) and the report-shape paragraph (`:2294-2300`): the gate alone may add `Intended red: N failed` for a base-overlay revert run that fails by design; `CheckReport` reads it into `Report.IntendedRed`, adds nothing to the Tests counts so a PASS is not refused for it, and ignores the line in any other role's report (adj 658). Mark nothing as proposed; the owner has decided it.
7. Run `slicer changelog add S649 --text "..."` for `landed-changed/S649.md`. Do not edit `CHANGELOG.md`.
8. Do not change the approval card, `runrec`, the brief text in `brief.go` or `states.go`, or the dashboard doc. `IntendedRed` is not stored or shown.
